---
title: 'Error keys'
description: 'Every error key the platform raises, for translating messages and matching on failures.'
---

<!-- Generated by `manablox docs generate`; edit the source, not this file. -->

Every error the platform raises carries a *key* (an identifier like
`content.slug.duplicate`) plus a `kind`, an HTTP status, and a list of *details*, each
with its own key, an optional path into the input (`['fields', 2, 'value']`) and
interpolation params. The key is what a client translates; the admin's sentences live in
[`@manablox/admin-sdk`](https://github.com/manablox/manablox-cms/blob/main/packages/admin-sdk/src/lib/messages.ts),
and the SDK exposes keys unchanged.

| Kind | Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `validation` | 422 | The input was understood and refused; the details say where. |
| `bad_request` | 400 | The request cannot be acted on as stated. |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | No principal. |
| `forbidden` | 403 | A principal without the permission. |
| `not_found` | 404 | The named thing does not exist, or is not visible to the caller. |
| `conflict` | 409 | The write collides with the current state: a stale version, a duplicate. |
| `too_large` | 413 | The body is larger than the limit, e.g. an upload past the file size limit. |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | Too many requests; wait for the `retry-after` header. |
| `unavailable` | 503 | The instance cannot serve yet, e.g. a public API with no space to serve. |
| `internal` | 500 | A bug or an outage. Masked on a public instance. |

## The error body

Every surface sends the same object:

```json
{
  "key": "validation.failed",
  "kind": "validation",
  "status": 422,
  "message": "validation.failed",
  "details": [
    { "key": "validation.invalid", "path": ["limit"], "params": { "code": "too_big", "maximum": 100 } }
  ]
}
```

`message` repeats the key, except for an unexpected error, which is always
`{ "key": "internal.error", "kind": "internal", "status": 500 }` with a fixed English
message and no details. On the public instance an `internal` error also drops its details.
Input that fails the schema of a procedure is `validation.failed` with one
`validation.invalid` detail per problem; its params carry the schema message and, when
known, `code`, `origin`, `expected`, `minimum` and `maximum`.

Where it travels:

| Surface | Carrier |
| --- | --- |
| REST (`/v1`, `/api/v1`), uploads, media, transfer, rate limits, unmatched paths | The response body `{ "error": { ... } }`, at `status`. |
| oRPC (`/rpc`) | The oRPC error: `code` from the kind, `message`, and the whole object as `data`. |
| GraphQL (`/graphql`) | Each entry of `errors`: `message`, plus `extensions` with `key`, `kind`, `status` and `details`. The HTTP status rules are in [GraphQL](../delivery/graphql.md#errors-and-http-status). |

An unmatched path answers `route.notFound` and a missing media file `asset.notFound` to a
client that accepts JSON (API paths always do); a browser or an image load gets a plain
text 404 instead.

GraphQL masking hides only unexpected errors: a `ManabloxError` such as an unknown
`type` argument keeps its key on a masked instance, while anything else reads
`Unexpected error.` with no key.

The catalogue is `ERROR_KEYS` of `@manablox/core`
([source](https://github.com/manablox/manablox-cms/blob/main/packages/core/src/error-keys.ts));
the `ManabloxError` factories and the validation collector only accept keys listed there. Field types report their own issue keys
through their value schemas; those pass through untyped and are not listed here.

## Plugin keys

Plugins declare keys of their own under `plugins.<id>`, with an English sentence each. The
plugins of the default instance:

### `plugins.license`

- `plugins.license.key.malformed`: That is not a license key. Keys look like MBX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX.
- `plugins.license.key.duplicate`: This key is added already.
- `plugins.license.key.notFound`: That key is no longer on this instance.
- `plugins.license.key.fromEnvironment`: This key comes from MANABLOX_LICENSE_KEYS; remove it from the environment instead.
- `plugins.license.key.notActivated`: This key is not activated on this instance.
- `plugins.license.key.invalid`: The license server does not know this key.
- `plugins.license.key.revoked`: This license key was revoked.
- `plugins.license.key.noSeats`: Every production seat of key {keyId} is taken. Deactivate one of its instances or add a seat.
- `plugins.license.key.trialUsed`: The trial of this product was used already.
- `plugins.license.key.bound`: This key is bound to another instance and cannot be moved.
- `plugins.license.cliSession.notFound`: That license session no longer exists; start again.
- `plugins.license.subscription.inactive`: The subscription of this key is not active.
- `plugins.license.activation.conflict`: This license is active on another instance. Activate it again here to move it.
- `plugins.license.activation.kindMismatch`: A development license serves private hosts only, and this instance has public ones ({hostnames}). Activate it as production.
- `plugins.license.activation.notFound`: The license server no longer knows this activation.
- `plugins.license.rateLimited`: The license server asks to wait {retryAfter} seconds.
- `plugins.license.request.invalid`: The license server refused the request.
- `plugins.license.network`: The license server cannot be reached: {reason}
- `plugins.license.server.failed`: The license server answered unexpectedly (HTTP {status}).

### `plugins.workflows`

- `plugins.workflows.code.immutable`: This workflow is declared in code. Edit it there, or clone it here.
- `plugins.workflows.notFound`: That workflow no longer exists.
- `plugins.workflows.validation.failed`: The workflow could not be saved - see the parts marked.
- `plugins.workflows.name.required`: A name is required.
- `plugins.workflows.trigger.eventsRequired`: Pick at least one event to start on.
- `plugins.workflows.trigger.eventUnknown`: The server does not know that event.
- `plugins.workflows.trigger.cronInvalid`: That schedule cannot be read - five fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday.
- `plugins.workflows.trigger.timezoneInvalid`: That timezone is not known.
- `plugins.workflows.trigger.typeNotFound`: One of the content types no longer exists.
- `plugins.workflows.abort.tooMany`: A workflow can have at most {max} abort triggers.
- `plugins.workflows.trigger.parameterInvalid`: Name the value with letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
- `plugins.workflows.trigger.parameterDuplicate`: Another value already goes by that name.
- `plugins.workflows.abort.eventsRequired`: Pick at least one event that aborts the run.
- `plugins.workflows.abort.eventUnknown`: That event cannot abort a run.
- `plugins.workflows.abort.keyRequired`: Matching by key needs a run key and an abort key.
- `plugins.workflows.abort.documentNeedsContent`: Matching the same document needs at least one content event.
- `plugins.workflows.abort.typeNotFound`: One of the content types no longer exists.
- `plugins.workflows.design.unavailable`: Designing a workflow from a description is not available here.
- `plugins.workflows.import.invalid`: That file is not a workflow export.
- `plugins.workflows.import.versionUnsupported`: That workflow file is from a newer version.
- `plugins.workflows.nodes.required`: A workflow needs at least one node.
- `plugins.workflows.node.idDuplicate`: Two nodes share an id - remove one and add it again.
- `plugins.workflows.node.keyRequired`: Give the node a name templates can use.
- `plugins.workflows.node.keyInvalid`: Use lower-case letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
- `plugins.workflows.node.keyDuplicate`: Another node already goes by that name.
- `plugins.workflows.node.unreachable`: Nothing leads here - join it up, or remove it.
- `plugins.workflows.node.kindUnknown`: The server does not know that kind of node.
- `plugins.workflows.edge.nodeUnknown`: That connection points at a node that is gone.
- `plugins.workflows.edge.portUnknown`: That connection leaves by a port this node does not have.
- `plugins.workflows.edge.selfLoop`: A node cannot lead back to itself.
- `plugins.workflows.edge.duplicate`: The same two nodes are already joined that way.
- `plugins.workflows.rule.operatorUnknown`: The server does not know that comparison.
- `plugins.workflows.graph.cycle`: These nodes lead back into each other, so the run would never end.
- `plugins.workflows.graph.startRequired`: Join at least one node to the trigger.
- `plugins.workflows.action.unknown`: No action of that kind is installed here.
- `plugins.workflows.action.duplicate`: Two actions claim the same name.
- `plugins.workflows.action.unavailable`: This instance cannot run that action.
- `plugins.workflows.action.credentialRequired`: Pick a credential for this action.
- `plugins.workflows.action.credentialKind`: That credential is not the kind this action needs.
- `plugins.workflows.reference.unknownNode`: No node goes by that name.
- `plugins.workflows.reference.notUpstream`: That node does not run before this one, so it has nothing to give it yet.
- `plugins.workflows.reference.outsideLoop`: Only a node inside a loop has a current item; this one is not after a "For each item" line.
- `plugins.workflows.loop.enteredFromOutside`: A line from outside the loop leads into its branch; the branch may only start from "For each item".
- `plugins.workflows.loop.waitInside`: A wait cannot be part of a loop.
- `plugins.workflows.call.targetRequired`: Pick the workflow to run.
- `plugins.workflows.call.targetNotFound`: That workflow no longer exists in this space.
- `plugins.workflows.call.targetNotCallable`: That workflow does not start "When another workflow runs it", so it cannot be run from here.
- `plugins.workflows.call.inputRequired`: The workflow it runs needs this value.
- `plugins.workflows.call.inputUnknown`: The workflow it runs takes no value by that name.
- `plugins.workflows.node.crawl.urlInvalid`: Enter a full http(s) address to start from.
- `plugins.workflows.node.content.typeRequired`: Pick the type of document to write.
- `plugins.workflows.node.content.idRequired`: Say which document to update.
- `plugins.workflows.node.transform.templateInvalid`: That is not valid JSON.
- `plugins.workflows.node.mail.fromRequired`: The credential has no from address, so give one here.
- `plugins.workflows.run.timeout`: The run took too long and was stopped.
- `plugins.workflows.run.aborted`: The run was aborted.
- `plugins.workflows.run.notActive`: That run has already ended.
- `plugins.workflows.run.workflowGone`: The workflow was deleted before the run could start.
- `plugins.workflows.run.outputUnreadable`: The output could not be read: {reason}
- `plugins.workflows.run.actionMissing`: No action named "{action}" is installed on this instance.
- `plugins.workflows.run.delayInLoop`: A wait cannot run inside a loop.
- `plugins.workflows.run.waitInLoop`: This action wanted to wait, which it cannot do inside a loop.
- `plugins.workflows.run.loopNotList`: "{template}" is not a list.
- `plugins.workflows.run.loopNoList`: The previous node handed over no list to go through.
- `plugins.workflows.run.loopItemFailed`: Item {item} failed: {reason}
- `plugins.workflows.run.loopCountInvalid`: "{count}" is not a number of times to repeat.
- `plugins.workflows.run.stopped`: {message}
- `plugins.workflows.run.callUnsupported`: This instance cannot run other workflows from a run.
- `plugins.workflows.run.callPausedInLoop`: "{name}" paused, which a loop cannot wait for; it carries on by itself.
- `plugins.workflows.run.calledRunGone`: The run it started no longer exists.
- `plugins.workflows.run.calledRunFailed`: "{name}" did not finish: {reason}
- `plugins.workflows.run.callTargetUnpublished`: "{name}" is not published yet.
- `plugins.workflows.run.callTargetDisabled`: "{name}" is switched off.
- `plugins.workflows.run.callCycle`: "{name}" is already running further up this chain of calls.
- `plugins.workflows.run.callTooDeep`: Workflows may only call each other {max} deep.
- `plugins.workflows.run.callInputMissing`: "{name}" needs a value for "{parameter}".
- `plugins.workflows.run.recipientMissing`: No recipient address came out of the fields given.
- `plugins.workflows.run.requestFailed`: {method} {url} failed: {reason}
- `plugins.workflows.run.httpStatus`: {method} {url} answered with HTTP {status}.
- `plugins.workflows.run.serviceStatus`: {service} answered with HTTP {status}: {reason}
- `plugins.workflows.run.tokenMissing`: {provider} handed back no access token.
- `plugins.workflows.run.pushFailed`: Every push failed: {reason}
- `plugins.workflows.run.crawlEmpty`: Nothing could be read from {url}. {reason}
- `plugins.workflows.run.pageStatus`: {url} answered with HTTP {status}.
- `plugins.workflows.run.notAPage`: {url} is {type}, not a page.
- `plugins.workflows.run.notADocument`: "{from}" is not a document an earlier node wrote.
- `plugins.workflows.node.email.recipientRequired`: Add an address or pick a role to send to.
- `plugins.workflows.node.email.recipientInvalid`: That is not an email address.
- `plugins.workflows.node.email.subjectRequired`: A subject is required.
- `plugins.workflows.node.http.urlInvalid`: Enter a full http(s) address.
- `plugins.workflows.node.http.headerNameInvalid`: That is not a valid header name.
- `plugins.workflows.node.push.recipientRequired`: Pick who should be notified.
- `plugins.workflows.node.push.titleRequired`: A title is required.
- `plugins.workflows.node.condition.rulesRequired`: Add at least one rule.
- `plugins.workflows.node.condition.fieldRequired`: Say which value the rule looks at.
- `plugins.workflows.node.delay.minutesInvalid`: Wait between one minute and thirty days.
- `plugins.workflows.node.loop.maxItemsInvalid`: Take between 1 and 500 items.
- `plugins.workflows.node.loop.countRequired`: Say how many times to repeat.
- `plugins.workflows.node.switch.fieldRequired`: Say which value the cases compare.
- `plugins.workflows.node.switch.casesRequired`: Add at least one case.
- `plugins.workflows.node.switch.tooManyCases`: A switch takes at most {max} cases.
- `plugins.workflows.node.switch.caseIdInvalid`: A case needs a port name of lowercase letters, digits and _.
- `plugins.workflows.node.switch.caseIdDuplicate`: Two cases share the port name "{id}".
- `plugins.workflows.run.notFound`: That run no longer exists.
- `plugins.workflows.run.createFailed`: The run could not be started.
- `plugins.workflows.run.documentRequired`: Pick a document to test this workflow against.
- `plugins.workflows.run.unpublished`: "{name}" is not published yet.
- `plugins.workflows.run.notManual`: "{name}" is not started by hand; its live version has another trigger.
- `plugins.workflows.run.disabled`: "{name}" is switched off.
- `plugins.workflows.run.inputMissing`: Fill in "{parameter}"; the workflow needs it.
- `plugins.workflows.version.notFound`: That version of the workflow does not exist.
- `plugins.workflows.create.failed`: The workflow could not be saved.
- `plugins.workflows.trigger.kindUnknown`: No installed plugin starts workflows this way ("{kind}").
- `plugins.workflows.abort.kindUnknown`: No installed plugin stops runs this way ("{kind}").
- `plugins.workflows.code.steps.required`: The workflow "{slug}" has no steps.
- `plugins.workflows.code.step.keyInvalid`: The step key "{key}" of "{slug}" must be lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.
- `plugins.workflows.code.step.keyDuplicate`: Two steps of "{slug}" share the key "{key}".
- `plugins.workflows.code.step.targetUnknown`: The step "{key}" of "{slug}" leads to "{target}", which is not a step.
- `plugins.workflows.code.step.portRequired`: The step "{key}" of "{slug}" must name the port it follows from.

### `plugins.webhooks`

- `plugins.webhooks.notFound`: That webhook no longer exists.
- `plugins.webhooks.validation.failed`: The webhook could not be saved - see the parts marked.
- `plugins.webhooks.create.failed`: The webhook was not stored.
- `plugins.webhooks.name.required`: A name is required.
- `plugins.webhooks.slug.invalid`: The name has to contain at least one letter or digit.
- `plugins.webhooks.slug.taken`: Another webhook of this space already has that address.
- `plugins.webhooks.url.required`: An outgoing webhook needs a URL to call.
- `plugins.webhooks.url.invalid`: That is not an http or https URL.
- `plugins.webhooks.event.unknown`: The server does not know that event.
- `plugins.webhooks.method.unknown`: The server does not know that method.
- `plugins.webhooks.header.nameInvalid`: That is not a valid header name.
- `plugins.webhooks.auth.credentialRequired`: This way of authenticating needs a credential.
- `plugins.webhooks.auth.credentialKind`: That credential is the wrong kind for this way of authenticating.
- `plugins.webhooks.auth.modeUnsupported`: That way of authenticating cannot be used in this direction.
- `plugins.webhooks.auth.signatureHeaderInvalid`: That is not a valid header name.
- `plugins.webhooks.direction.mismatch`: A webhook cannot change direction - create a new one.
- `plugins.webhooks.delivery.notFound`: That call is no longer in the log.
- `plugins.webhooks.delivery.requestFailed`: {method} {url} failed: {reason}
- `plugins.webhooks.delivery.httpStatus`: {method} {url} answered with HTTP {status}.
- `plugins.webhooks.delivery.notRetryable`: Only an outgoing call can be sent again.
- `plugins.webhooks.unauthorized`: The call did not prove who it was.
- `plugins.webhooks.disabled`: The endpoint is switched off.
- `plugins.webhooks.methodNotAllowed`: The endpoint does not accept that method.
- `plugins.webhooks.payload.invalid`: The body could not be read.
- `plugins.webhooks.payload.tooLarge`: The body is larger than an incoming call may be.
- `plugins.webhooks.code.immutable`: This endpoint is declared in code and cannot be edited here.
- `plugins.webhooks.trigger.required`: Pick the incoming webhook this workflow starts from.
- `plugins.webhooks.trigger.notFound`: That incoming webhook no longer exists in this space.
- `plugins.webhooks.abort.required`: Pick the incoming webhook that aborts the run.
- `plugins.webhooks.abort.notFound`: That incoming webhook no longer exists in this space.
- `plugins.webhooks.code.url.required`: The outgoing webhook "{slug}" needs a URL.
- `plugins.webhooks.code.auth.modeUnsupported`: The {direction} webhook "{slug}" cannot authenticate with "{mode}".
- `plugins.webhooks.code.auth.credentialRequired`: The webhook "{slug}" authenticates with "{mode}" and needs a {kind} credential.

### `plugins.ai`

- `plugins.ai.provider.notFound`: That provider is not set up in this space.
- `plugins.ai.provider.notConfigured`: No AI provider in this space can do that yet - add one under Settings, AI.
- `plugins.ai.provider.disabled`: That provider is switched off for this space.
- `plugins.ai.provider.kind.unknown`: This version does not know that provider.
- `plugins.ai.provider.kind.taken`: That provider is already set up in this space.
- `plugins.ai.provider.apiKey.required`: That provider has no API key stored yet.
- `plugins.ai.provider.capability.unsupported`: That provider cannot generate that kind of thing.
- `plugins.ai.provider.model.notOffered`: That provider does not offer that model for this job.
- `plugins.ai.provider.model.notFound`: This key cannot see the model chosen here - pick another one on the card.
- `plugins.ai.provider.unreachable`: The provider could not be reached.
- `plugins.ai.request.failed`: The provider refused the request.
- `plugins.ai.response.empty`: The provider returned nothing.
- `plugins.ai.response.filtered`: The provider withheld the answer under its content policy. Rephrase the prompt.
- `plugins.ai.response.truncated`: The answer hit the output limit and was cut off. Ask for less or raise the limit.
- `plugins.ai.response.unusable`: The provider answered with something that could not be used.
- `plugins.ai.prompt.required`: Say what to generate.
- `plugins.ai.generation.notFound`: That generation no longer exists.
- `plugins.ai.generation.failed`: The generation failed.
- `plugins.ai.generation.notReady`: The provider is still working - it took longer than allowed.
- `plugins.ai.generation.noAsset`: The generation produced no file.
- `plugins.ai.document.type.notFound`: That content type no longer exists.
- `plugins.ai.document.type.noTextFields`: This content type has no text fields to write.
- `plugins.ai.provider.custom.slugInvalid`: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
- `plugins.ai.provider.custom.baseUrlInvalid`: The base URL has to be an http or https address.
- `plugins.ai.provider.custom.hostNotAllowed`: That server is on the private network. An administrator has to add it to the instance's allowed AI hosts (the plugin's allowedHosts option, usually set with AI_ALLOWED_HOSTS) and restart the instance.
- `plugins.ai.settings.lengths.invalid`: Every length needs its own name and a number of words.
- `plugins.ai.design.empty`: The model did not design anything usable. Describe it again, more precisely.
- `plugins.ai.workflow.promptRequired`: Say what the model should write.
- `plugins.ai.workflow.promptEmpty`: The prompt came out empty once its placeholders were filled.
- `plugins.ai.workflow.pictureFailed`: The picture could not be drawn: {reason}
- `plugins.ai.workflow.pictureTimeout`: The picture was not ready after {seconds} seconds.
- `plugins.ai.workflow.typeGone`: The type of document to write no longer exists.
- `plugins.ai.workflow.notJson`: The model did not answer with JSON: {excerpt}
- `plugins.ai.license.host`: AI runs on a development license here, which serves only local and private hosts. A public host needs a production license.

### `plugins.website`

- `plugins.website.settings.validation.failed`: The site settings could not be saved - see the parts marked.
- `plugins.website.design.notFound`: That design no longer exists.
- `plugins.website.design.validation.failed`: The design could not be saved - some values are not accepted.
- `plugins.website.design.invalid`: This value is not accepted.
- `plugins.website.design.versionConflict`: Someone else saved this design while you were editing - reload it to see their changes.
- `plugins.website.design.version.notFound`: That version of the design no longer exists.
- `plugins.website.design.key.invalid`: There is nothing of that name to design in this space.
- `plugins.website.design.notPublished`: That design has not been published yet.
- `plugins.website.design.share.invalidExpiry`: A preview link lasts between a minute and 30 days.
- `plugins.website.theme.notFound`: That theme is not in the gallery of this space.
- `plugins.website.theme.preset.notFound`: There is no site design of that name.
- `plugins.website.theme.bundle.invalid`: That file is not a Manablox theme, or it is damaged: {issues}
- `plugins.website.theme.code.invalid`: A theme defined in code is not valid: {issues}
- `plugins.website.domain.notFound`: That domain no longer exists.
- `plugins.website.domain.validation.failed`: The domain could not be saved - see the fields marked.
- `plugins.website.domain.hostname.invalid`: Enter a host name like www.example.com, without http:// or a path.
- `plugins.website.domain.hostname.taken`: Another space already uses that domain.
- `plugins.website.domain.locale.unknown`: This space does not have the locale "{locale}".
